# HandleHunt

> Find and browse rare short Instagram usernames. Session-based exhaustive 3/4-character scanners, availability estimates, and a Telegram marketplace for listed handles.

HandleHunt is an independent discovery tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with Meta Platforms, Inc. or Instagram.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://handlehunt-xi-tau.vercel.app/): Hero, single-handle check, exhaustive scanner, marketplace carousel, testimonials
- [Scanner](https://handlehunt-xi-tau.vercel.app/#scanner): Exhaustive a-z0-9 combinations for 3 and 4 character handles
- [Marketplace](https://handlehunt-xi-tau.vercel.app/#marketplace): Listed handles with Buy (Telegram) and Out of stock states
- [Privacy Policy](https://handlehunt-xi-tau.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://handlehunt-xi-tau.vercel.app/terms)
- [Disclaimer](https://handlehunt-xi-tau.vercel.app/disclaimer)

## Product facts

- Scanner runs only while the browser tab is open; progress can be saved in local browser storage
- Availability results are estimates from public profile signals, not official Instagram registration status
- Purchases and transfers happen off-site via Telegram (https://t.me/rareinsta)
- No on-site payment processing

## Contact
